captures.text:

Promptify

Practical skills for working with AI
Learn to work effectively with AI.

Practice real workplace scenarios, get immediate feedback and learn to improve prompts — no technical background required.

Start learning with Google
See how it works

For office professionals. No programming knowledge required.

Same task. Two outcomes.
Vague prompt
Write an email
about the meeting.
AI RESULT

Hello everyone, there will be a meeting soon. Please join if you can.

Missing the time, recipients and required action
Structured prompt
Email the project team
Meeting: Friday 9:00, room A3
Confirm by Thursday 17:00
Maximum 80 words
AI RESULT

Subject: Confirm Friday's meeting

Hello team, please confirm attendance at Friday's 9:00 meeting in room A3 by Thursday 17:00.

Clear task. Clear deadline. Ready to use.
The prompt determines the direction.

The goal stays the same. How you assign the task determines whether AI wanders or produces actionable results.

SAME GOAL
Prioritize project tasks
UNCLEAR DIRECTION
“What should I do now?”
Missing role, context and constraints
Generic suggestions
Needs further editing before assignment
Wasted time
Memory waste
Digital clutter
CLEAR DIRECTION
Role + task + constraints
Act as a project manager. Use progress and deadlines to select three priorities.
Priorities ready to assign
Each task has an owner, deadline and reason
Frequent AI use does not mean effective AI use.

Many employees already ask AI questions, yet still waste time because the results are not ready to use.

01
Inconsistent results

The same task produces different answers: sometimes relevant, sometimes unfocused.

02
Repeated revisions

Extra explanations take time when the original request lacks context, constraints and output format.

03
Hard to identify prompt issues

When results fall short, users often rewrite at random without identifying missing prompt components.

Three principles for working with AI

Control the output to use AI safely and accurately in everyday work.

01
Assign tasks clearly

Tell AI exactly what you need and what the result should look like.

02
Control the result

Use examples, limits and structure to reduce revisions.

03
Work with trusted data

Know when AI must follow existing documents, data or policies.

How Promptify helps you improve

Learn through comparative practice: write, test and receive immediate feedback to build clear task-setting habits.

1
FIRST STEP
Write prompts for real scenarios

Work with real documents, proposals and emails. Write your own prompt using your business knowledge.

2
DIRECT EXECUTION
Run with an AI model

Run your prompt and inspect the result. Check that it meets your intention and task requirements.

3
CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
Get feedback and improve

The system analyzes your prompt, identifies strengths and gaps, and suggests improvements for the next run.

Apply it to everyday work

Turn clear AI instructions into productivity for familiar office tasks.

Draft emails

Write appropriate rejection letters, policy explanations and partner correspondence.

Prepare reports

Combine multiple sources into clear, coherent periodic reports.

Summarize long documents

Extract key points from proposals, contracts and meeting minutes.

Classify records

Route customer feedback by priority and classification criteria.

Extract tables

Extract indicators from raw text directly into Excel or Sheets.

Search internal documents

Find relevant clauses and evidence in business procedure manuals.

Start working more clearly with AI.

Practice today to make AI a useful partner in your work.

Sign in with Google
A safe and secure internal training environment

Promptify © 2026 • Prompt Engineering practice for enterprise professionals
